diagnosis.first_person: Spreading native DOMPointReadOnly loses inherited coordinates and yields invalid first-person transforms. Explicit x/y/z copying and finite checks repair the reproduced defect. Earlier plain-object hardware mocks concealed it.
diagnosis.menus: Menus are placed once in the current gaze, rendered independently of scene depth, and use the original handlers through nonmodal immersive dialogs. B return and nested menu access are retained. Frame exceptions trigger explicit recovery instead of permanently halting XR callbacks.
